complete.context.sub_unwatch: Stop watching an attached context for file changes
complete.rewind.sub_compact: Undo the latest compaction (restore the pre-compaction history)
help.command.context_lifecycle: Context lifecycle: what is in the window now, re-read the sources, watch/unwatch a context for changes.
help.command.memory_tools: Long-term memory tools: export/import the stores, recall facts on demand, explain why a fact was recalled.
help.command.autocompact: Show or set the automatic compaction threshold (share of the context window).
help.command.cost: Session and daily spend per provider/model, cache telemetry; reset, last session, history, export (JSON or CSV).
help.command.config_ops: Managed (org) configuration and the retention policy for sessions, transcripts, parks and memory queues.
help.command.config_security_ops: Re-seal every store with the current encryption key; verify the tamper-evident audit trail.
